messages:
Ana: quick q — we need a default routing heuristic for requests that don't send X-Redwood-Version. current behavior falls back to v2, which is fine for most, but it's causing quota spikes for some legacy tenants. thoughts?
Devin: +1 we keep seeing tenants hit unexpected billing when they land on v2. can we prefer the version their token historically used?
Kevin: Prefer historical-token-affinity sounds sensible. but what about new tokens with no history? maybe use UA SDK sniffing then fallback to v2?
Mira: SDK UA sniff may be noisy. what about a simple confidence ranking: 1) explicit header, 2) token affinity (last 7d), 3) console tenant override, 4) v2 default. seems predictable.
Ana: agrees. also we should record a telemetry field that explains WHY we routed a particular version (e.g., routed_version=v1, routing_reason=token_affinity). ops/infra needs that for debugging.
Devin: +telemetry. propose these tags: routed_version, routing_reason, token_history_count, sdk_hint. ops-bot: noted — add to request logs and sampling pipeline.
Mira: console UX ask: add per-tenant routing override with TTL (24h/7d) and an audit entry. simple toggle: "prefer v1 for undetected clients". infra can use that as a hard override before heuristics.
Kevin: also add a circuit-breaker: if a tenant's error rate increases >5% after routing change, auto-revert to previous version for a rolling 30m probe. reduces blast radius.
Ana: good. can we add a small header for downstream callers so they can see decisions? e.g.:
```
X-Redwood-Routed: v1; reason=token_affinity; sample=0.12
```
Devin: that helps support. also include a short hash of the tenant override id so console links can deep-link to the override.
Mira: telemetry needs event for "version_negotiation" with fields: tenant_id, routed_version, prev_affinity, reason, override_flag. we should sample 1% globally and 10% for errors.
Kevin: quota accounting question — do we bill differently by routed model or by API surface? customers saw double-charging when a v1->v2 routing changed token billing class. we need to normalize: billing should be by effective model variant used, but show a migration delta report in console for 7 days after a routing change.
Ana: agree, show a "routing impact" banner in console for tenants with recent overrides. include token_velocity and estimated cost delta.
Devin: implementation notes: runtime change is small — routing layer consults token-affinity store (LRU with ttl), then tenant-override store, then SDK-hint matcher, then default. add small config toggles behind feature flag.
ops-bot: deploy-bot scheduled a canary for this Friday 03:00 UTC to staging with feature flag off by default. runbook: if we see >2% increase in 5xxs for canary tokens, rollback.
deploy-bot: canary job created: job/route-heuristic-canary-20240303, pinging eng-platform for monitoring window.
Ana: next steps: (1) Kevin/Mira to draft telemetry schema PR, (2) Devin to sketch console override UX, (3) infra to add token-affinity store design. i'll own the runbook and rollout plan.
Kevin: will do telemetry PR today.
Mira: I'll mock the console toggle and the impact banner.
Devin: will stub SDK UA hinting logic and list which UA strings to map.
Ana: thanks all. keeping this lightweight — aim to ship behind flag next week. :thumbsup:
